detailed_description: The Pie Chart Generator is a specialized tool for transforming numerical datasets into visual pie charts through programmatic data interpolation and vector-based rendering. This tool leverages browser-native Canvas API and SVG DOM manipulation to create resolution-independent visualizations that maintain clarity at any scale. By accepting structured data inputs in CSV or JSON formats, it calculates proportional segments using geometric algorithms that translate percentage values into precise radian measurements for arc rendering. Developers and data analysts benefit from its ability to automate chart generation for dashboards, while marketers use it to illustrate market share distributions. The backend employs a two-pass rendering process: first normalizing input values to compute slice angles via the formula θ = (value/total) * 2π, then applying anti-aliased stroke paths for polished display. Users can customize color gradients with HEX/RGB pickers, adjust radial offsets through a polar coordinate interface, and enable interactive tooltips that display exact value percentages on hover. Exported assets retain vector properties in SVG format or convert to high-DPI PNG raster images with adjustable pixel density up to 600ppi, ideal for print or web presentations.
usage_steps: Open the tool's data input panel and paste structured numerical data using the CSV template format (label,value pairs)
Activate the 'Dynamic Colors' toggle to auto-generate chromatic scales or manually assign hex codes through the palette grid
Adjust the 'Slice Offset' slider to create exploded segments, specifying degrees of separation from the chart center
Configure legend orientation using the compass-direction dropdown (N, S, E, W) with adjustable font size controls
Enable the '3D Projection' switch to render depth-enhanced segments with customizable light source angles
Select export resolution (SVG or PNG) and download the generated visualization with embedded metadata preservation
usage_examples: A financial analyst creates quarterly revenue breakdowns with 3D pie charts, applying corporate branding colors through HEX codes for investor presentations
An educational researcher visualizes student major distributions using exploded segments to highlight specific departments
A UX designer prototypes interactive dashboard components by exporting SVG charts with tooltip event listeners pre-attached
A government agency generates public report infographics with multi-layered legends positioned dynamically around the chart circumference
